## Biography

Abel Embaye is Clinical Associate Professor of Economics at the University of Arkansas. His research interests include public finance, labor economics and African economies..

## Education

- PhD in Economics, 2007, Georgia State University

- Masters in Economics, 1999, Tilburg University

- BA in Economics, 1995, Asmara University

## Research Interests 

- Public Finance
- Labor Economics
- African Economies
